title: SoftBank, Fortress and the Vision Fund

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Acquired dives into the topic on the minds and lips of just about every VC and founder these days.
reader_summary.overview: Acquired dives into the topic on the minds and lips of just about every VC and founder these days: SoftBank’s $93B+ Vision Fund. Where did this new 800lbs gorilla come from, what are its goals. The answer, it turns out, starts with an acquisition, and unfolds into a story no one has yet told and few yet understand.

key_points.text: Acquired dives into the topic on the minds and lips of just about every VC and founder these days: SoftBank’s $93B+ Vision Fund.
